displayOrder.prompt:
Redesign the TripLOG transport and accommodation reservation summaries shown in the reference as a compact “Boarding Pass & Stay Key” UI concept, at a natural 682 × 241 component viewport. Make the two summaries more distinctive and informative within TripLOG’s existing paper, passport and ticket visual language. Use two adjacent ticket surfaces: give each category a compact header, make the representative reservation the main reading focus, and place its count in a clearly separated perforated end stub with an opening chevron. Preserve the reference’s Korean labels, counts and reservation information. Use compact Pretendard-like Korean typography, restrained ink outlines, warm paper #fffdf7, sky blue #bce6fb, pink #f7afc7, and small yellow #ffeb50 accents. Use purposeful alignment and subtle paper depth. Render only the component as app UI. The current date is 2026-10-03; retain any source dates.

A few visible ticket edges give the wallet depth while the two rows remain easy to scan. Preserve the reference’s Korean category labels, counts and reservation information. Render the component as app UI with purposeful spacing and aligned text. The current date anchor is 2026-10-03; use dates only if already present in the source.

displayOrder.prompt:
Redesign the TripLOG reservation summaries as a compact “Passport Pockets” UI concept, at a natural 682 × 241 component viewport. Connect the reservation component visually to the user’s selected home design. Use two adjacent passport pockets with upright reservation cards partly tucked into them. Put each category label at the top, its count on a small upper corner tab, the representative reservation prominently on the visible card, and a clear opening chevron along the pocket edge. Preserve all Korean category labels, counts and reservation information from the reservation reference. Keep the composition practical as flat, front-facing app UI, with compact Pretendard-like typography, subtle stitching and paper texture, warm paper #fffdf7, ink #202730, sky blue #bce6fb, pink #f7afc7, and restrained yellow #ffeb50 details. The current date anchor is 2026-10-03; use dates only if already present in the reservation source.
